items.title: Insufficient test coverage
items.detail: Only 2 test files for the entire NestJS API. No unit tests for Phase 3 services.

items.title: In-memory state prevents horizontal scaling
items.detail: userSpend, authIpTracker, spendTtl, blacklistedTokens are all in-memory Maps. Restart = data loss. Cannot run >1 instance.

items.title: Custom JWT implementation vs standard library
items.detail: HMAC-SHA256 JWT created manually in shared/security.js. Works but lacks standard features (kid, jwk, expiration validation robustness).

items.title: Hardcoded localhost service addresses
items.detail: SERVICES config in gateway.js has hardcoded localhost:3001-3004. Should be environment-configurable.

items.title: No request validation library
items.detail: Manual validation in each route handler. No class-validator or Joi for request schemas.

items.title: Magic number timeouts
items.detail: 6 instances of hardcoded timeout values (10000ms, 30000ms, etc.) in service code.

items.title: No TypeScript in Phase 3 services
items.detail: Phase 3 services are plain JavaScript. No type safety, harder to refactor.
